rule: eligible means Architect-authorized, dependency-complete, conflict-safe and dispatched from the current governed main head
context: WAVE J OPEN (2026-09-26): ACR-006 is the approved forward architecture extension for Application Execution Compatibility. The program now tests a strict AI_EXECUTION_COMPLETE property across real independent applications. PPR-017 builds the Application Execution Graph, compatibility/evidence harness and website Demo Mirror foundation; PPR-018 certifies Aider; PPR-019 certifies Cline. These three are conflict-safe under the max-three-worker rule and use the same pre-approved compatibility contract. PPR-016 remains operator-bound on GAP-002 capability credentials/access and is blocked rather than silently treated as runnable. Planned successor applications are OpenHands, Continue, Hermes-Agent, OpenClaw, Browser Use, Open WebUI and AnythingLLM. Completeness is never redefined to make demos pass.
